info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Create Fooddelivery Deliveries Create-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Creation API enables users to initiate new food delivery orders within the system. This endpoint allows businesses to manage their delivery logistics by submitting food delivery requests with essential details such as delivery address, customer information, and items ordered. It is particularly useful for restaurants or delivery services aiming to streamline their order fulfillment processes. Developers can integrate this API to facilitate seamless order creation directly from their applications, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new delivery by providing the required details. It will process the request and return the status of the newly created delivery along with any relevant information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new delivery entry. It should contain all the necessary details for the delivery including recipient information, delivery address, and any specific instructions.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the delivery.

customer.description: Information about the customer placing the delivery request.

resource.description: The resource associated with the delivery.

priority.description: The priority level of the delivery request.

amount.description: The amount associated with the delivery.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denoted.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required for this delivery.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the delivery was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the delivery request is made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in a sequential dataset.

CreateFooddeliveryDeliveriesCreateReques.description: This schema represents the request body for creating a delivery operation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

CreateFooddeliveryDeliveriesCreateRespon.title: Delivery Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the delivery operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the delivery operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

CreateFooddeliveryDeliveriesCreateRespon.description: Response schema for the delivery operation creation. It includes status, identifiers, processing time, and audit information.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the delivery.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the delivery operation was created.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the creation of the delivery operation, including created by, creation time, and whether it was automated.
